name: Shamgar
title: The Judge with the Ox Goad
summary: Shamgar was one of Israel's judges, known for his unusual feat: he killed 600 Philistines with an ox goad. He is mentioned only briefly in the Bible, but his action helped free Israel from Philistine oppression.

keyEvents.title: Killed 600 Philistines
keyEvents.description: Shamgar struck down 600 Philistines with an ox goad, thus saving Israel from their enemies. This was a remarkable feat accomplished with an improvised weapon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Song of Deborah
keyEvents.description: In the victory song of Deborah and Barak, Shamgar's days are mentioned as a time when roads lay deserted and people had to travel on winding paths, indicating uncertain times in Israel.
